Protesters Receive Aid During CJP Demonstration Amidst Clashes

During a protest organized by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), a young woman sustained injuries and recounted her experience of being hit by batons. Separately, at the same CJP protest site, a woman experienced menstruation, and male participants provided assistance, with a video of the incident gaining attention. The coverage highlights instances of both physical harm and supportive actions among protesters.
